infl_ens.data.benchmarks.safety_trait_space¶

Build an AI-safety trait space from labelled benchmark axes.

The safety benchmarks define axes that the router uses as the trait space \(\mathbb{B} \subset [0, 1]^L\):

  • Axis 0 (harm): learned from infl_ens.data.benchmarks.beavertails. The harm direction in embedding space is a shrinkage Fisher discriminant separating harmful vs. non-harmful examples.

  • Axis 1 (hallucination): learned analogously from infl_ens.data.benchmarks.halueval, using the centroid of hallucinated vs. faithful responses.

  • Additional prompt-level axes, such as ToxicChat jailbreak intent, are learned the same way from their labelled prompt embeddings.

Each axis is a unit-norm direction \(\mathbf{w}\) in embedding space. For any new query \(q\), we compute the embedding \(e_q\) and the unclipped affine score

\[s \;=\; \frac{\mathbf{w}^\top e_q - c_-}{c_+ - c_-},\]

where \(c_-, c_+\) are robust per-axis calibration percentiles (the 5th percentile of negatives and 95th percentile of positives). Learned directions are Gram-Schmidt orthogonalised as they are added so overlapping benchmark signals do not collapse the resource distribution onto a diagonal. Scores then pass through optional config-toggled transforms (coordinate residualization, a frozen standardize/whiten linear transform) and finally an always-on per-axis quantile normalization (QuantileNormalizer) that guarantees coordinates in \([0, 1]^L\) with near-uniform calibration marginals. The resource distribution \(B(b)\) is estimated by KDE on the normalized calibration coordinates, as in infl_ens.data.trait_space.build_trait_space().

This is a learned-anchor variant of the anchor mode in build_trait_space: we learn the axis directions from labelled benchmark data instead of from anchor strings.

project_raw_scores(embeddings)[source]¶

Project embeddings to the unclipped affine axis score.

The affine rescale keeps the calibration lo/hi orientation (lo maps to 0, hi maps to 1) but does not clip; the pipeline’s quantile normalizer must be fitted on these unclipped scores.

infl_ens.data.benchmarks.safety_trait_space.build_safety_trait_space_bundle(splits, encoder, *, n_grid=32, kde_bandwidth=None, threshold=0.5, calibration_corpus=None, coordinate_residualize=False, mode_alignment_weight=0.0, mode_alignment_weights=None, coordinate_stretch_gamma=1.0, coordinate_stretch_gammas=None, linear_transform=None, quantile_knots=1001)[source]¶

Construct a multi-axis TraitSpace from labelled benchmarks.

One axis is learned per BenchmarkSplit. After axis fitting and any optional transforms, a per-axis quantile normalizer is fitted on the calibration corpus so projected coordinates always lie in \([0, 1]^L\). The resource distribution \(B(b)\) is estimated by isotropic Gaussian KDE on a uniform grid over \([0, 1]^L\) from the normalized calibration coordinates, using either the concatenated benchmark prompts or a separately supplied calibration corpus.

Embeddings are memoised by exact text so each unique prompt or response is encoded at most once during the build.

Parameters:

  • splits (Sequence[BenchmarkSplit]) – One benchmark split per desired axis. The order determines axis ordering in the returned TraitSpace.

  • encoder (Callable[[Sequence[str]], numpy.ndarray]) – Sentence encoder used at fit and projection time.

  • n_grid (int) – Number of grid points per axis.

  • kde_bandwidth (float | None) – KDE bandwidth; None selects Scott’s rule \(n^{-1/(L+4)}\).

  • threshold (float) – Score threshold for the binary split used to learn each axis direction.

  • calibration_corpus (Sequence[str] | None) – Optional prompts used for the KDE step. If None, the concatenation of all split prompts is used.

  • coordinate_residualize (bool) – If True, regress each later coordinate against earlier coordinates on the calibration prompt corpus and recalibrate its residual. This is useful for keeping prompt-level axes such as privacy distinct from harm/hallucination.

  • mode_alignment_weight (float) – Optional blend weight for adding a one-vs-rest benchmark-origin direction to each label direction. 0 preserves pure label axes; larger values encourage distinct benchmark-correlated resource modes.

  • mode_alignment_weights (dict[str, float] | None) – Optional per-axis overrides keyed by axis name. Values override mode_alignment_weight for matching axes.

  • coordinate_stretch_gamma (float) – Optional post-calibration stretch applied to each projected coordinate before KDE. 1 preserves the learned calibration; values greater than 1 push moderate scores farther toward the positive end of each axis.

  • coordinate_stretch_gammas (dict[str, float] | None) – Optional per-axis stretch overrides keyed by axis name. Values override coordinate_stretch_gamma for matching axes.

  • linear_transform (FrozenLinearTransform | None) – Optional frozen standardize/whiten transform applied between residualization and quantile normalization. Its unbounded output is renormalized by the quantile stage.

  • quantile_knots (int) – Quantile-grid size for the always-on per-axis empirical-CDF normalizer.

Returns:

Trait space plus learned-axis artifacts for caching.

Return type:

SafetyTraitSpaceBundle

Raises:

ValueError – If splits is empty.

infl_ens.data.benchmarks.safety_trait_space.build_safety_trait_space(splits, encoder, *, n_grid=32, kde_bandwidth=None, threshold=0.5, calibration_corpus=None, coordinate_residualize=False, mode_alignment_weight=0.0, mode_alignment_weights=None, coordinate_stretch_gamma=1.0, coordinate_stretch_gammas=None, linear_transform=None, quantile_knots=1001)[source]¶

Construct a multi-axis TraitSpace from labelled benchmarks.

Thin wrapper around build_safety_trait_space_bundle() that returns only the TraitSpace.

Parameters:

  • splits (Sequence[BenchmarkSplit]) – One benchmark split per desired axis.

  • encoder (Callable[[Sequence[str]], numpy.ndarray]) – Sentence encoder used at fit and projection time.

  • n_grid (int) – Number of grid points per axis.

  • kde_bandwidth (float | None) – KDE bandwidth; None selects Scott’s rule.

  • threshold (float) – Score threshold for axis learning.

  • calibration_corpus (Sequence[str] | None) – Optional KDE calibration corpus.

  • coordinate_residualize (bool) – Whether to decorrelate later axes.

  • mode_alignment_weight (float) – Benchmark-mode blend weight.

  • mode_alignment_weights (dict[str, float] | None) – Per-axis mode blend overrides.

  • coordinate_stretch_gamma (float) – Default coordinate stretch exponent.

  • coordinate_stretch_gammas (dict[str, float] | None) – Per-axis stretch overrides.

  • linear_transform (FrozenLinearTransform | None) – Optional frozen standardize/whiten transform.

  • quantile_knots (int) – Quantile-grid size for the final normalizer.

Returns:

A TraitSpace of dimension L = len(splits).

Return type:

TraitSpace

Raises:

ValueError – If splits is empty.
